two_signal_shape.note: EPC certificate payload carries no dwelling count field found by key search; measured absence, not an omission.

wording_constraints: The result is an age BAND, not a year. Any downstream use must state the band; ES/FR sidecars carry observed years and are not interchangeable with this.

EPC coverage is CERTIFICATE coverage, not a building-stock census. A dwelling holds an EPC only if sold, let or newly built since 2008. A GB percentage placed beside the ES 98.74 percent without this sentence is a category error.
registrationDate is the certificate's lodgement date, never a construction year.

cp3_verdict.signed_by: director, under owner delegation "tu progress comme tu recommends avec CP3, vas-y"
reasons: The observed quantity is an RdSAP construction-age BAND, not a year. S3 as executed for FR and ES consumes an OBSERVED per-building year; turning a band into a year is ASSIGNMENT, which is the exact ground on which Italy was ruled out under D-EU-22.

Dwelling count is a MEASURED ABSENCE in the certificate payload, so GB does not reproduce the two-signal shape (observed year + dwelling count) that typed France and Spain and that the EU-04 layout contract needs.

Coverage is CERTIFICATE coverage -- 797 of 1,219 strict-join footprints, 65.38 percent -- over a sold/let/new-since-2008 population, not a stock census. It is not comparable to the ES 98.74 percent and must never be printed beside it.
S3 is already PROMOTED at 95 of 96 under D-EU-24 and eu_campaign_cell_spec_v1.0.json is FROZEN_PINNED. Admitting a third country would reopen a signed campaign and move every idf_sha256.
cp3_verdict.what_is_retained: The credential works and the London site is now MEASURED, not credential-blocked. The probe artefacts (gb_uprn_join.csv, gb_epc_certificates.csv, the two caches) stand as evidence for any FUTURE band-based enlargement. Enlarging S3 to a band-based country is a SEPARATE request and is not granted here.
cp3_verdict.wording_that_must_travel: London is no longer credential-blocked -- its coverage is measured at 65.38 percent of 1,219 strict-join footprints, as an age BAND, on a certificate population. It stays out of S3 for a quantity-mismatch reason, not an access reason.
